author: Yffe
content: Add a test-only forge-level Divergent teeth in forge/src/exec_tv.rs: a #[cfg(test)] mod that builds real exec obligations with a deliberately-wrong P_production and discharges them through the actual private `discharge` fn (reached via super::, no visibility tweak), asserting Faithful (control), Divergent via postcondition counterexample, Divergent via non-compile (#122 paren-drop), and Unverifiable for a degenerate zero-obligation program. No production-logic change. Gauntlet: build + test --workspace + clippy -D warnings + fmt --check + cargo tree -p thermite-tv (no thermite-lower).
